help.exclude:
As of v1.2.0, it is possible to exclude certain folders from sync.

During sync, the plugin first looks at the excludes list to see if a file (or folder) is not excluded, and only then it checks for files in the included list.

For example, if folder /a/** is included, but file /a/b is excluded, all files except for b would be backed up.
help.include.or.exclude.subf:
There may be cases where it is necessary to only back up a folder without recursively digging deeper into subfolders. For those cases you can use option 'Folder (exclude subfolders)'.

Such cases are quite niche; in general the 'Folder' option should be used instead.
help.file.picker.fail:
